Chinmaya Vidyalaya Model United Nations
Chinmaya Vidyalaya Model United Nations was organized in the
school premises on September 21st, 24th and 25th. 80 participants
from classes 9, 10, 11 & 12 became delegates who represented 22
countries. There were 4 committees of United Nations: - DISEC,
UNHRC, UNEP and UNSC. It was inaugurated by the General
Secretary -Thomas Babychan of class XII D. During the closing
ceremony The City Police Commissioner of Thrissur- Sri. Yathish
Chandra GH IPS, was the Chief Guest. He had an interactive
session with the delegates. The best delegates were honored with
trophies and certificates. The vision of CVMUN was to help our
students to think beyond their limits and help them develop their
diplomatic and speaking skills. The motive of CVMUN was to:
Imagine, Innovate, and Inspire.
The 40th Annual Day Celebrations
Member of Parliament Shri. Suresh Gopi who is also a popular and
versatile actor inaugurated the 40th Annual Day Celebrations on
the 9th Feb 2019 and addressed the audience. H.H. Swami
Viviktananda Saraswathi, Regional Head, Chinmaya Mission, Kerala
exhorted the audience to imbibe the principles enshrined in the
Chinmaya Vision Programme, through his presidential address.
This was followed by an explosion of talents in the form of
'Kaladarshika' where students right from Pre-KG to Std XII were
given a platform to exhibit their inherent potentials in music,
dance, drama, comedy etc., individually and in large and small
groups. It was indeed an audio visual treat leaving the audience
wanting for more The Ruby Jubilee Celebrations culminated with
the grand finale on 8th and 9th Feb 2019. A visual treat of the folk
Arts of Kerala was arranged in the Vidyalaya for the students
Ruby Jubilee Grand Finale Inauguration
Ceremony
The same evening a cultural fiesta was inaugurated by Smt. KPAC
Lalitha, Chairperson of Kerala Sangeetha Nataka Academy in the
presence of our Acharya H.H.Swami Gabheeranandaji. The
teachers, alumni and parents showcased their talents and
creativity through solo and group performances enthralling the
audience.
Ruby Jubilee Inauguration Ceremony
Chinmaya Vidyalaya Thrissur inaugurated the observance of its
Ruby jubilee Year (40th Year ) on 30th July 2018 . It was an occasion
to both commemorate and cherish those experiences that allowed
us to grow and to go beyond all expectations. The function began
with the lighting of the ceremonial lamp by H.H Swami
Viviktananda Saraswathi, Regional Head â€“Chinmaya Mission
Kerala State. The inaugural address by the Chief Guest Sri
Jayarajan Rajasekharan Nair, a National award winning film
director. It was rightly decided to begin the programmes
connected with the Ruby jubilee by honouring four eminent and
erudite GURU's in various fields through "GURUVANDANAM". We
hope their blessing and guidance will help us scale greater heights
in the years to come.
Chinmaya Vidyalaya can boast of an addition to its list of
innovations. We have introduced a monthly newsletter 'Chinmaya
Vani' encapsulating the activities of the Vidyalaya along with the
creative contribution of the students. These news letters were
compiled and created by the Fine Arts Vice Captains. It was
released in a solemn function.

Annual Day
The 39th Annual day was celeberated on 14th February 2018. The
chief guest of the day was Dr V VUnnikrishnan Dean, University of
Health Science. Our Vice Principal welcomed the gathering. Our
Principal presented the Annual report followed by the inaugural
address by the Chief Guest. Our Director G Mukundanhonoured
retiring Principal SmtShobhanaDevadas on this august occasion.
SmtNirmalaHaridas teacher of Commerce Departmentwas also
honoured on her retirement from service. The Head boy and Head
Girl shared their reminiscences. The formal programme came to
an end with the vote of thanks by our Headmistress. It was
followed by a cultural fiesta by the students which was well
appreciated by the well-wishers for the maximum participation
and grandeur.
